node.title: Task-to-Tool / Model Routing — right model per task
node.summary: Identifies which tool-model pairings work best for each kind of work and recommends the right model per task type.
node.interview_question: Routing changes weekly as models ship — how is your recommendation anything but stale by the time it's acted on?

competitor.name: Cursor
competitor.positioning: Cursor and other IDEs already let developers pick/route models in-session; native routing undercuts an external recommendation layer.
